title: Science Night Telescope
question: 把今天“昂贵设备出故障 -> 找到 faulty part -> repair -> 到某个时间点已经产生清晰结果”的工程线，放进学校科学夜场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: Our science club set up a telescope camera for science night. The first moon pictures were disappointing because the lens was faulty. We were going to put it right before the parents arrived. My classmate held the camera while I made the necessary repairs. By the time the parents arrived, it had sent clear pictures to the classroom screen.
